svg.title: Conventional powder-in-tube (PIT) route for MgB2 wire and MRI coils

g.text: CONVENTIONAL POWDER-IN-TUBE (PIT) ROUTE FOR MgB2 WIRE & MRI COILS
In situ reaction route: elemental Mg + 2B powders to barrier-sheathed multifilament wire to persistent-mode MRI magnet
STAGE 1 to 4: BILLET PREPARATION AND RESTACKING
STAGE 5 to 8: DRAWING, HEAT TREATMENT AND MRI MAGNET
